news.title: Boy George visits Nova massacre site ahead of Tel Aviv concerts dedicated to survivors

news.title: Shin Bet Unit 730 will take over Yashar party leader Eisenkot's security, source tells 'Post'
news.summary: Yashar previously announced that a private company would begin protecting Eisenkot under Unit 730’s direct instruction. The latest decision would replace that arrangement with direct protection.

news.title: Hapoel Tel Aviv soccer edges Maccabi Haifa as Beersheba rallies, Maccabi Tel Aviv cruises
news.summary: Hapoel Tel Aviv held off Maccabi Haifa 2-1, while Beersheba staged a dramatic 5-2 comeback and Maccabi Tel Aviv cruised to a commanding 5-0 victory.

news.title: Tel Aviv University unveils October 7 memorial honoring victims of attack
news.summary: Designed by architect Lihi Davidovich Ein Gedi, the memorial features engraved commemorative messages and a digital archive preserving nearly 1,000 memorial stickers

news.title: UK artist David Breuer-Weil to launch Tel Aviv solo exhibition focused on Oct. 7
news.summary: His upcoming Tel Aviv showcase brings together a body of work addressing the tragedy of the Oct. 7 massacre, the emotional return of the hostages, and complex questions surrounding Jewish identity.

news.title: Israel rolls out red carpet for Boy George: 'I'm getting more Jewish'
news.summary: Ahead of his Tel Aviv concerts, Boy George met President Isaac Herzog and Hamas captivity survivor Elkana Bohbot, speaking about his support for Israel and the personal cost of taking a public stand

news.title: This Halloween, a few ghosts and ghouls were just what Tel Aviv needed
news.summary: Purim may be Israel's traditional costume holiday, but Halloween is catching on in Tel Aviv, where more than 5,000 children went trick-or-treating this year in the growing neighborhood tradition
